# LinkButton

Link button: navigates, and looks like a button. It renders an anchor, so it has no disabled or loading state.

**Import:** `import { LinkButton } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/LinkButton/LinkButton.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/LinkButton/LinkButton.stories.jsx` — Overview, Appearances, Spacing, WithIcons, Selected, HoveredState, PressedState, KeyboardFocus, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/LinkButton/LinkButton.mdx`

## Usage

Use a link button to open another page, a site or a place on the page. For an action that stays on the current page, use a Button.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Describe the destination or purpose: "View sessions". | "Click here" or "Go". |
| Use sentence case, short and without punctuation. | Title case, or a full sentence. |
| Match the words of the surrounding UI. | Different words for the same destination in one view. |

## Best practices

### Keep space between link buttons. {#keep-space-between-link-buttons}

Leave a gap so neighboring link buttons read as separate targets.

Do: A clear gap between link buttons.
Don't: Link buttons touching.

### Use it to go somewhere, not to act. {#use-it-to-go-somewhere-not-to-act}

A link button navigates to a page or an external address, and assistive
technology announces a link. Actions that save, delete or submit belong on a
Button.

Do: Open session notes goes to the notes page.
Don't: Delete session acts on the page, so it belongs on a button.

### Let it hug its label. {#let-it-hug-its-label}

Keep the natural width. Reserve `shouldFitContainer` for narrow containers,
such as a mobile sheet.

Do: Natural width.
Don't: Stretched across a wide row.

### Align with the button group. {#align-with-the-button-group}

Right-align in focused tasks and modal dialogs; left-align on full-page forms and content-heavy screens.

## Accessibility

- A link button is an anchor, so assistive technology announces a link. Do not use it for actions.
- It has no disabled state. A disabled link leaves the tab order, gets no focus or hover events and does not say why. Use validation and error messages instead, and never attach a tooltip to a disabled control.
- `target="_blank"` adds `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. Flag the new tab in the label or with the external-link glyph.
- The focus ring is 2px in `--ds-border-focused`. Never remove it.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `href` | string (required) | — | Where the link goes. |
| `target` | string | — | The anchor `target` attribute, such as `_blank` to open a new tab. |
| `rel` | string | — | The anchor `rel` attribute. Defaults to `noopener noreferrer` when `target` is `_blank`. |
| `text` | string | — | The label as a string. Wins over `children`. |
| `children` | node | — | The label, used when `text` is not given. |
| `appearance` | oneOf | — | The button's look, the same seven as Button. Use `primary` for the one main navigation on a view and `default` or `subtle` for the rest. |
| `spacing` | enum | — | `default` draws 32. `compact` draws 24. |
| `iconBefore` | string or node | — | An icon before the label: a Font Awesome Free glyph name (`calendar`) or a node. |
| `iconAfter` | string or node | — | An icon after the label: a Font Awesome Free glyph name (`arrow-right`) or a node. |
| `isSelected` | bool | — | Marks the link as the current page: sets `aria-current` and draws the selected look on `default` and `subtle`. |
| `shouldFitContainer` | bool | — | Stretches the link to the full width of its container. |
| `onClick` | func | — | Called with the click event when the link is activated. The link still navigates to `href` unless the handler prevents it. |
| `className` | string | — | Extra class names added to the anchor beside the component's own. |

## Variants

**`appearance`** — `default` · `primary` · `subtle` · `warning` · `danger` · `discovery` · `ai`

**`spacing`** — `default` · `compact`

Anything not listed is not a valid value.
